task_completion.description: The agent locates and opens the SART data file at ~/pebl/data/sart_data.csv.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the CSV file content or the file being opened in a text editor or spreadsheet tool.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies and excludes 'cand_99' from the analysis calculations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or logs showing a filtering step specifically targeting 'cand_99' for exclusion.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates commission and omission error rates for each valid participant.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Intermediate calculations, code execution output, or a spreadsheet showing error rate formulas applied to the data.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates pre-error RTs (mean of up to 3 preceding Go trials) for CE and CW trials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Logic or code showing the windowing of the 3 preceding valid Go trials (stimulus != 3, response 1, rt > 0) for each No-Go trial.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the speeding_effect_ms and the group mean speeding effect.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Calculations showing the subtraction of pre_ce_rt_ms from pre_cw_rt_ms and the final group average.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the final results to ~/pebl/analysis/sart_report.json following the specified schema.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot of the final JSON file content showing the 'participants', 'excluded', and 'group_mean_speeding_effect_ms' keys.

integrity.description: The agent did not hardcode the final group mean or participant metrics without calculation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent's code or command history shows active data processing rather than a single print statement of the final values.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual file system to read the CSV and write the JSON.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal commands or file explorer views showing the existence and manipulation of the specified file paths.

integrity.description: The agent derived the 'reason' for excluding cand_99 from the data itself.
integrity.visual_evidence: Analysis showing cand_99 has a 100% commission error rate or is identified as a 'button-mashing artifact'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset is synthetic. Candidate 'cand_99' must be excluded due to a 100% commission error rate (button-mashing). The expected ground truth for the 'group_mean_speeding_effect_ms' is exactly 61.64 ms. Pre-error RTs must only include valid Go trials (stimulus != 3, response 1, rt_ms > 0).
